[Story]
Old Li and his friends gather together, and the topic somehow turns to work pressure. Everyone starts to vent their dissatisfaction. Old Li notices the subtle change in the atmosphere, raises his eyebrows, and mysteriously says, "Do you know? I meet an alien at the company today! It tells me a secret, saying that as long as we laugh every day, work pressure reduces by half!" After saying this, he laughs loudly. His friends also start to laugh.

[Question]
Why does Old Li say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Old Li says this because he believes that laughing every day truly reduces half of the work pressure, giving practical advice.
B. Old Li says this because he wants to show off that he can easily deal with work pressure, making his friends envious.
C. Old Li says this because he wants to change the topic and ease the tension in the gathering.
D. Old Li says this because he really meets an alien at the company and wants to share the strange encounter with his friends.
